One mixed run three ways: collapsed; while it runs (counts so far, the kind still going with …, the step in progress beneath); opened. The section labels are the board's, not the app's.
A folded run, then the step waiting on you on its own line and the review card docked below. Nothing that asks for a decision is folded.
NOW: every command open in full. PROPOSED: a line a command; output on a click (3 lines + Show n more lines, as before).
NOW: every edit open to its diff. PROPOSED: folded, counts kept; one opened (a long diff shows 12 lines + Show n more lines).

NOW: each agent open to its report. PROPOSED: a finished agent folds to one line; a running one keeps its own line with Manage in Terminal….
NOW: one step per update. PROPOSED: one To-dos · 3 of 5 done line, kept current; opened to the checklist.
NOW: raw tool names. PROPOSED: counted by their server or kind; opened, a line each.
The run stays folded; its line ends · 1 failed in red. Opened, the failed step shows its error.
Over 12 lines: the first 8 and Show all n lines.
The console tab strip while the selected tab is in chat mode: 28 high, ground, SF Pro 12, the selected tab underlined, a light toggle.
